title: The upload is shared fairly
acceptanceCriteria: The operator states a budget for remote viewers.
A new stream starts at the best version that fits, and running streams step down when the budget tightens, rather than anyone being refused.
The household comes before friends, and friends before a community.
The viewer is told why their quality dropped.
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.
